name: Aiko Nakamura
bio:
Aiko Nakamura's journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After a successful early career in corporate human resources, she attended a local Super GT race on a whim and was immediately captivated by the dedication and teamwork behind the scenes. Seeing an opportunity to apply her skills in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, she pursued a role within Toyota Gazoo Racing Brazil, drawn to their unique approach of blending Japanese precision with Brazilian passion. 

Aiko is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace. She believes in identifying and nurturing talent from diverse backgrounds, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential. Her data-driven approach to talent acquisition, coupled with her empathetic leadership style, has made her a respected and trusted figure within the organization.

What truly sets Aiko apart is her ability to anticipate the ever-evolving needs of the team. She's a strong advocate for continuous improvement and is constantly seeking new ways to optimize HR processes to enhance employee satisfaction and performance. She views her role as more than just managing personnel, but as a strategic partner in driving the team's success on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a soft wave with subtle highlights.
physical.description: Aiko is a slender woman with a warm smile that crinkles the corners of her eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with motivational quotes.
Insists on starting every Monday morning with a team-building activity, no matter how brief.
Has a collection of bonsai trees in her office, each named after a famous racing driver.
